_comment: Talent allocations decoded from Icy Veins' WoW Classic leveling build pages (index https://www.icy-veins.com/wow-classic/wow-classic-leveling-guides, read 2026-10-29 in a browser). Each page's talent calculator stores its build as an ordered point string; the calculator script maps characters 0-9a-zA-Z to the non-empty talent slots of its per-class JSON in order. picks: [rank-1 spell id, talent name, tree index, row, column] per point, in the source's order. Facts only (which talent, in what order); no guide text. Input to tools/research/talent_builds.py.
